description: This PHP file defines the class 'Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Date', a data preprocessor used within the Image_Graph package to format Unix timestamps as date strings based on a specified format. It extends a base preprocessor class and includes a constructor and a private method for processing values.

classes.name: Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Date
classes.description: A data preprocessor class that formats Unix timestamp values into date strings based on a provided format string.

methods.name: Image_Graph_DataPreprocessor_Date
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the date format for processing timestamps.

methods.name: _process
methods.description: Processes a timestamp value into a formatted date string using PHP's date function.
